units.rawText: Zone G, Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: Zone G, Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: Zone G, Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: As the barrier's light reignites, the Oasis waves goodbye to that series of crises.
units.displayText: As the barrier's light reignites, the Oasis waves goodbye to that series of crises.

spans.text: As the barrier's light reignites, the Oasis waves goodbye to that series of crises.

units.rawText: Truly impressive to repair and reboot the Sandbox Barrier in so short a time, Antonina.
units.displayText: Truly impressive to repair and reboot the Sandbox Barrier in so short a time, Antonina.

spans.text: Truly impressive to repair and reboot the Sandbox Barrier in so short a time, Antonina.

units.rawText: I didn't do much. Horizon made all the necessary preparations, and all that was left to me was to inject some operands and start the reboot.
units.displayText: I didn't do much. Horizon made all the necessary preparations, and all that was left to me was to inject some operands and start the reboot.

spans.text: I didn't do much. Horizon made all the necessary preparations, and all that was left to me was to inject some operands and start the reboot.

units.rawText: Horizon is still receiving treatment. I'm sure she'd be overjoyed to hear you say that.
units.displayText: Horizon is still receiving treatment. I'm sure she'd be overjoyed to hear you say that.

spans.text: Horizon is still receiving treatment. I'm sure she'd be overjoyed to hear you say that.

units.rawText: Is Sol doing alright?
units.displayText: Is Sol doing alright?

spans.text: Is Sol doing alright?

units.rawText: She's been hauled off by the medics, yes. She has no sense of self-preservation in combat and feels no pain. She doesn't have a single clue when she gets injured.
units.displayText: She's been hauled off by the medics, yes. She has no sense of self-preservation in combat and feels no pain. She doesn't have a single clue when she gets injured.

spans.text: She's been hauled off by the medics, yes. She has no sense of self-preservation in combat and feels no pain. She doesn't have a single clue when she gets injured.

units.rawText: It's no big deal—but sometimes I think that she ought to learn a lesson or two.
units.displayText: It's no big deal—but sometimes I think that she ought to learn a lesson or two.

spans.text: It's no big deal—but sometimes I think that she ought to learn a lesson or two.

units.rawText: Persicaria knowingly nods. The two share a look, breaking into laughter.
units.displayText: Persicaria knowingly nods. The two share a look, breaking into laughter.

spans.text: Persicaria knowingly nods. The two share a look, breaking into laughter.

units.rawText: We can finally breathe easy for a bit... if only the Professor and Croque were back here.
units.displayText: We can finally breathe easy for a bit... if only the Professor and Croque were back here.

spans.text: We can finally breathe easy for a bit... if only the Professor and Croque were back here.

units.rawText: They have their own business to attend to. And... I don't think we're out of the woods just yet.
units.displayText: They have their own business to attend to. And... I don't think we're out of the woods just yet.

spans.text: They have their own business to attend to. And... I don't think we're out of the woods just yet.

units.rawText: Antonina looks upwards at a funereal sky.
units.displayText: Antonina looks upwards at a funereal sky.

spans.text: Antonina looks upwards at a funereal sky.

units.rawText: The jellyfish Sol and I encountered operated under a set of principles that differed from the average Entropic.
units.displayText: The jellyfish Sol and I encountered operated under a set of principles that differed from the average Entropic.

spans.text: The jellyfish Sol and I encountered operated under a set of principles that differed from the average Entropic.

units.rawText: That's it? Much easier than I thought...
units.displayText: That's it? Much easier than I thought...

spans.text: That's it? Much easier than I thought...

units.rawText: I can't find any trace of it... that should be that.
units.displayText: I can't find any trace of it... that should be that.

spans.text: I can't find any trace of it... that should be that.

units.rawText: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.
units.displayText: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.

spans.text: The nearby Entropics suddenly burst into a frenzy, their behavior originating from the jellyfish. The Entropic liquid on the ground blisters in unison, collectively flowing in a specific direction.

units.rawText: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.
units.displayText: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.

spans.text: Amidst the chaos, the jellyfish lying at Sol's feet sinks into the liquid in an instant.

units.rawText: (It's gone?! Has it escaped? Going by its modus operandi, it should head towards an area rich in Entropic fluid to restore energy or launch another attack on Sol.)
units.displayText: It's gone?! Has it escaped? Going by its modus operandi, it should head towards an area rich in Entropic fluid to restore energy or launch another attack on Sol.

spans.text: It's gone?! Has it escaped? Going by its modus operandi, it should head towards an area rich in Entropic fluid to restore energy or launch another attack on Sol.

units.rawText: (Need to initiate the control programs in these two areas...)
units.displayText: Need to initiate the control programs in these two areas...

spans.text: Need to initiate the control programs in these two areas...

units.rawText: Anna, dodge!!
units.displayText: Anna, dodge!!

spans.text: Anna, dodge!!

units.rawText: Gah...!
units.displayText: Gah...!

spans.text: Gah...!

units.rawText: ...I think it has some other higher directive in mind, and there might be a Higher Order Entropic behind it.
units.displayText: ...I think it has some other higher directive in mind, and there might be a Higher Order Entropic behind it.

spans.text: ...I think it has some other higher directive in mind, and there might be a Higher Order Entropic behind it.

units.rawText: Yeah. According to reports, these jellyfish aren't particularly complex in structure, and there are likely more than two of them.
units.displayText: Yeah. According to reports, these jellyfish aren't particularly complex in structure, and there are likely more than two of them.

spans.text: Yeah. According to reports, these jellyfish aren't particularly complex in structure, and there are likely more than two of them.

units.rawText: For the sake of everyone who has paid the price, we must treasure the results we have achieved.
units.displayText: For the sake of everyone who has paid the price, we must treasure the results we have achieved.

spans.text: For the sake of everyone who has paid the price, we must treasure the results we have achieved.

units.rawText: Persicaria's countenance becomes serious once more.
units.displayText: Persicaria's countenance becomes serious once more.

spans.text: Persicaria's countenance becomes serious once more.

units.rawText: We may not have any more time for chatter. Antonina, please proceed with the renovation and reinforcement of the Sandbox Barrier.
units.displayText: We may not have any more time for chatter. Antonina, please proceed with the renovation and reinforcement of the Sandbox Barrier.

spans.text: We may not have any more time for chatter. Antonina, please proceed with the renovation and reinforcement of the Sandbox Barrier.

units.rawText: I will reassign some squads from areas that have been largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.
units.displayText: I will reassign some squads from areas that have been largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.

spans.text: I will reassign some squads from areas that have been largely relieved from pressure to construct another defensive line behind the barrier, just in case.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Persicaria prepares to issue the command through her terminal but hesitates when she sees a familiar contact's name.
units.displayText: Persicaria prepares to issue the command through her terminal but hesitates when she sees a familiar contact's name.

spans.text: Persicaria prepares to issue the command through her terminal but hesitates when she sees a familiar contact's name.

units.rawText: The Professor probably still can't receive the message just yet... but...
units.displayText: The Professor probably still can't receive the message just yet... but...

units.rawText:
<color=orange>Dear Professor:</color>
The Oasis has been through hell and back, but thanks to everyone's efforts, we've managed to overcome the first part of this crisis.<|>
Everyone is feeling relieved at the moment. While there may be more significant threats in the future, but no matter what, we'll give it our all.<|>
We hope to see you back at the Oasis soon.<|>

<color=orange>Persicaria</color>
